name: Rhea
tagline: Saturn's second-largest moon — a bright, battered ice world at the edge of the ring plane.
history: Rhea is Saturn's second-largest moon — a frozen body whose low density shows it is mostly water ice over a small rocky core. Cassini imaged its bright wispy terrain and crisp crater chains; debris once suspected to form a faint ring system around it turned out to be a magnetospheric effect. It is the archetype of Saturn's mid-size moons: old, cold, and quietly cratered.
